subtitle: Acquisition & Specialization Intelligence
changes: Added Acquisition Intelligence inside Loot Hunter using the existing, limited curated historical source file and the player's manually tracked farming goals.
Added source-coverage filters, reference guide links, documented acquisition steps, personal attempt summaries and clear indicators when no acquisition reference is available.

Added Specialization Intelligence inside Talent Forge showing Blizzard-returned node IDs, supplied descriptions, category filters, available spell/talent IDs, planned rank counts, and source-tree context.
The new intelligence views are read-only; they do not modify loot goals, talent allocations, saved builds, account information, or music.
Preserved previous Warcraft Research and the v7.7.2 music and Founder layout. Live browser and player testing remains outstanding.
